Container.Name: Calvin
Container.Overview: Calvin is a self-hosted Raspberry Pi dashboard for calendars, photos, web services, and plugins. On Unraid, run this container as the backend and point one or more Raspberry Pi kiosk displays at the WebUI URL.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the Calvin web UI and API.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent Calvin data: SQLite database, images, and installed plugins.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: Database URL used by Calvin. The default stores SQLite inside Appdata.

Config.Name: Image Directory
Config.Description: Container path where Calvin stores and reads image files.

Config.Name: Plugin Directory
Config.Description: Container path where Calvin stores installed plugins.

Config.Name: CORS Origins
Config.Description: Allowed CORS origins. Usually not needed for kiosk use because Calvin serves the frontend and API from the same origin.
